Naturally, one finds the quiet melancholy of the periphery quite exhausting, my dear Vance.
Of course, the final indignity is watching one of our own expire in this unappealing patch of dirt.
Naturally, one tires of witnessing such barbaric consumption of provisions within a space intended for aesthetic contemplation.
Of course, the destruction of the billiards table provides yet another canvas upon which to lament.
Naturally, it is quite a spectacle to witness such needless misery marching into the unforgiving wilderness.
Naturally, these rather primitive brigands choose this deplorable morning to decide upon an encounter.
Naturally, dining upon the detritus of this frontier does not constitute proper nourishment.
Naturally, this tepid insect jelly paired with the humble kibble offers rather little to the palate.
